122260.overview: Command heroic knight Sir Arthur on a quest to defeat the forces of evil and save kindnaped princess Prin Prin. Scores of evil enemies awaits you , from zombies to gargoyles , ghosts to demons on your journey to save her. Will you survive the perils that lie in haunted countryside of demon world?

185638.overview: Golden Axe Genesis is a fan-made sequel to the arcade beat 'em ups from the 90's, featuring new enemies, graphics, faster gameplay and an overhaul to the balance and design. Developed by SEEP, a two-man team of brothers from Italy, it was made using the OpenBOR engine and offers 13 playable heroes and numerous villains to battle from the franchise's saga. There's a Story mode and a survival mini-game called Duel mode, as well as the ability to play the arcade original with the new characters and updates.

185675.overview:
Battle your way over land, sea and air down into the depths of Cobra Island, in an attempt to stop a doomsday missile from being launched by Cobra Commander! 

G.I. Joe: Attack on Cobra Island is an OpenBOR beat 'em up starring everyone's favorite Joes, such as Snake Eyes, Duke, and unlockables like Hawk and Sgt. Slaughter, with several missions, updated sprites, new enemies and more!

185798.overview:
The council of Defensors was tricked and misguided. The four best warriors of the whole realm are already on pursuit of the enemy. The council gave them the power of Elemental Magic, since great are the dangers they'll have to face. They know no fear or doubt. In their hearts and minds there's only the sacred quest: to get back the Golden Axe.

Developed by a small team of fans from Argentina, Golden Axe Myth is a spiritual successor to Sega's 1989 arcade classic, Golden Axe, and runs on the open-source Beats of Rage engine, the foundation of many homebrew beat 'em ups.

Fight your way through 16 different locations and choose from 4 main fighters -- barbarian Ax Battler, amazon Tyris Flare, dwarf Gilius Thunderhead, and Death Adder, the game's original villain -- with bonus characters who can join the party in later stages. All heroes have different strengths and weaknesses, and you can pick up and play from where you left off with another character, should you die.

Brief cutscenes tell the story, with branching paths and hidden areas along the way. In addition to magic jars, grab power-ups to increase your strength and defense, and money to buy items in the shops. The mechanics have been expanded to allow vertical rolls, blocking and additional special movies like Rage Mode.

The game was one of the first OpenBOR projects to feature totally original art and was widely praised for its production and overall fun factor.

200556.overview:
THE ULTIMATE GOLDEN AXE REMAKE! The Legend of Golden Axe lives on. Choose from a variety of warriors and take up arms against evil in this world spanning adventure that combines the best features of each home console port.

* The original story revisited!
* 7 characters from Golden Axe 1, 2 and 3 to choose from!
* All characters have long/short range combos and custom throws, plus they can run, block, counter, and perform astonishing Special Moves!
* Fill your magic meter and unleash the ultimate magic!
* Find and ride the 4 different bizarrians, each with his own attack!
* Enemies and bosses from Golden Axe 1, 2 and 3! Plus some surprises!
* Choose your destiny, with multiple paths available! Will you find the path leading to the TRUE final battle?
* Survival and training modes, where you can fight hordes of enemies and train your moves!

210510.overview: A four player feat em up created with OpenBOR, featuring Japan's three biggest Kaiju Heroes!

212953.overview: With the added improvements, all the flaws are removed and you play a cleaner version where the battles are fought with ease. Bios meat screens have also been improved, which now give you more accurate information about your character's condition.Gilius Thunderhead, Ax Butler and Tyris Flare, will be your heroes. They are the fighters of the original game and here their skills are significantly improved.

212954.overview:
Golden Axe: The Curse of Death Adder is a fangame based on the classic fighting game Golden Axe developed in the OpenBOR engine.

With graphics ripped from several games in the franchise and, along with the gameplay, fun, sounds and music, you get the impression that you're playing an original Golden Axe from the arcade with more elements and difficulty. It also features sounds and snippets of music from Conan movies. In addition, you can play multiplayer and has three game modes.

219007.overview:
The story of this game takes place after Golden Axe 3 and before Golden Axe: Revenge of Death Adder.

Everyone is here! Dora, Trix, Tyris, Sara, Kain, and all the rest. Pick your favorite battle hardened hero and choose your path. Swap weapons on the fly for tons of combinations. Grab three of your friends and take on the hordes in an all out four player war!

Have Fun!

344948.overview:
Golden Axe: Genesis is a tribute to the trilogy of Sega Mega Drive (Genesis of the United States of America). There will be all the characters in the trilogy, updated and arranged so that everyone is calibrated and consistent with each other. Of course it includes special blows and spells. It includes many known enemies and the possibility of mounting Svarianti beasts. The game will be wrapped in a new and unusual story with new additions in gameplay as mutilation (very similar to Mortal Kombat's fatality).

Finally, available for Sega Dreamcast! Now Golden Ax: Genesis V3.0 is compatible with Dreambor by Ian Micheal. I have fixed and added many new features, as I have also optimized the game for greater use of the RAM of the Sega Dreamcast.

425715.overview: Golden Axe: Genesis is a tribute to the trilogy of Sega Geneis (Mega Drive of the World). There will be all the characters in the trilogy, updated and arranged so that everyone is calibrated and consistent with each other. Of course it includes special blows and spells. It includes many known enemies and the possibility of mounting Svarianti beasts. The game will be wrapped in a new and unusual story with new additions in gameplay as mutilation (very similar to Mortal Kombat's fatality). Finally, available for Sega Dreamcast! Now Golden Ax: Genesis V3.01 is compatible with Dreambor by Ian Micheal. I have fixed and added many new features, as I have also optimized the game for greater use of the RAM of the Sega Dreamcast.

453152.overview:
Gudule is an all-original project by @tontonMayonnaise, who had created these characters years before in middle school before putting them to use in an OpenBOR project. The game is set in a sword and sorcery world with humorous aesthetics and anthropomorphic pigs serving as adversaries. Players take control of Gudule the Barbarian as he battles his way through a mighty porcine army.

As of 2021-04-07, the project is canceled. The creator described his reasons for leaving the project as personal in nature, while also citing a new preference for working on first person shooter projects.

455516.overview: Well, many of us have enjoyed these classic 8- and 16-bit games, and of course, it's a delight to have the opportunity to reminisce about old glory days. Well, that's what we have in this game, with all the flavor of the '80s and '90s on 21st-century retro consoles using the OpenBOR engine. So, get ready to grab your Sega DreamCast controller and relive those afternoons of the good old days...

463547.overview:
Developed by a small team of fans from Argentina, Golden Axe Myth is a spiritual successor to Sega's 1989 arcade classic, Golden Axe, and runs on the open-source Beats of Rage engine, the foundation of many homebrew beat 'em ups.

This light version is TEST since it was released on April 24, 2011 (v1.0) in SPK format using the old OpenBORv3.0 Build 2123 engine and re-converted to PAK format on December 19, 2019 for the current OpenBOR v3.0 Build 6412, which contains errors in both graphics and code interpretation in this version of DreamBOR.

472597.overview:
Take back the Golden Axe in this modified version of utunnels' popular remake, made by kimono. 

* 32 playable characters (instead of 3 in 1.4)
* New Skeleton select (with blood + stage 0 WIP) Eagle Stage, a bonus stage between the Castle and the Extended Level (a remastered Genesis Showdown level)
* An in-game NPC menu
* Plenty of new attacks like a stab (mid-range attack), special down, forward, attack, and up/down attack attacks
* Defensive moves: a dodge (double tap up or down), holding the back button on Pain for a small backward jump, holding the forward button for a charge to escape an attack
* An auto-regen by not touching any commands for a certain period of time
